summary: Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc. (formerly Bed Bath & Beyond) filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $200 million of common stock through sales agent JonesTrading Institutional Services. Shares will be sold at prevailing market prices, with a 2.0% commission. The prior ATM had ~$16 million remaining. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation.
